what: The tool surface the BestPrice.gr storefront registers, extracted from the source of truth in the bestprice.gr repository.
extraction: webmcp/src/contract-parity.js extractToolDefinitions (object literals carrying name + inputSchema, module-scope schema constants resolved)

get_page_product.title: Product details on this page
get_page_product.description: Return the product, current minimum price, rating, and offer count shown on this BestPrice item page.

compare_page_offers.title: Compare offers on this page
compare_page_offers.description: Compare up to four rendered offers by item price, shipping, delivered price, availability, and merchant rating. Every offer carries an offer_ref for show_offer. stores_considered of stores_total says how many stores were ranked; completeness partial means more are behind «Όλες οι τιμές» (include_all_stores loads them).

limit.description: Number of lowest-delivered-price offers to return, from 1 to 4.

include_all_stores.description: First load the stores this page keeps behind «Όλες οι τιμές», as when the shopper presses it. Defaults to false.

get_product_specifications.title: Product specifications
get_product_specifications.description: Return structured specifications for the product on this BestPrice item page, optionally focused on one specification section or one fact. Follow next_offset with the same section to read omitted facts. A shortened value is marked truncated; ask for that fact by name to read it in full.

section.description: Use all or a section name shown on this product, such as Οθόνη, Ισχύς, or Διαστάσεις.

limit.description: Maximum number of specification facts to return, from 1 to 16.

fact.description: A specification fact name, such as one a previous call returned. Returns that fact in full, from whichever section lists it; pass its section too when the name appears in more than one section.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result, keeping the same product and section. Defaults to 0. Do not combine with fact.

summarize_price_history.title: Price history summary
summarize_price_history.description: Return the current, lowest, and highest recorded prices plus recent and overall price direction for this BestPrice product.

show_offer.title: Show an offer for this product
show_offer.description: Scroll this BestPrice item page to one merchant offer it already shows and mark it for the shopper. Use the offer_ref returned by compare_page_offers; merchant_name (or a merchant_id from the page markup) also works when it identifies exactly one shown offer. It never opens a merchant page and never exposes a merchant URL.

offer_ref.description: Page-local offer reference from compare_page_offers. Exact, and the only selector that can separate two stores with the same displayed name. A reference names one quote: it is refused once the page state, the merchant, the variant or any price or shipping amount changes; read the offers again.

merchant_id.description: Numeric merchant id as the page markup shows it (data-mid); compare_page_offers does not return it, so prefer offer_ref.

merchant_name.description: Merchant name exactly as compare_page_offers returned it.

show_price_history.title: Show this product price history
show_price_history.description: Open or focus the price-history chart for the product currently shown on the BestPrice item page.

get_visible_products.title: Products on this page
get_visible_products.description: Return up to eight products currently rendered on this BestPrice listing page. Follow next_offset to read the rest; open one with open_visible_product and its product_id.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result on the same page. Defaults to 0.

open_visible_product.title: Open a visible product
open_visible_product.description: Open a product currently rendered on this BestPrice listing page, using its returned product ID.

product_id.description: Numeric product ID returned by get_visible_products.

get_listing_filters.title: Available filters
get_listing_filters.description: Return the selected and available values from filters on this listing page, including values behind «Εμφάνιση όλων». Pass group to read one filter in full; follow next_offset to continue.

group.description: A filter key or name a previous call returned; returns that filter with all of its values.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result with the same group, or none. Defaults to 0.

apply_listing_filter.title: Apply a filter
apply_listing_filter.description: Apply a filter value this listing offers, including one behind «Εμφάνιση όλων», using the same navigation as a shopper. Exact or one unambiguous partial label works.

value.description: Visible filter value or unique partial label.

clear_listing_filters.title: Clear filters
clear_listing_filters.description: Clear the filters currently applied to this BestPrice listing page.

get_listing_sort_options.title: Available sorting options
get_listing_sort_options.description: Return the sorting options currently rendered on this BestPrice listing page.

apply_listing_sort.title: Sort this product listing
apply_listing_sort.description: Apply a visible sorting option by its full label or one unambiguous partial label.

sort.description: Visible sorting option or unique partial label.

search_bestprice.title: Search BestPrice products
search_bestprice.description: Start a BestPrice product search and navigate this browser tab to the results.

query.description: Product, brand, model, or shopping need to search for.
